payload.text:
Build a high-fidelity Tennis Match Statistics App called "NTP Stat." Use the provided screenshots to guide the UI layout, and information density.

1. Navigation & State Management
Bottom Navigation: Three tabs: Matches (List of previous games), Players (Directory), and Shot Stats (Active match tracking).
Persistent Storage: Use a local database (like SQLite or Hive) to save Player Profiles and completed Match Logs.

2. Player Profile Requirements
Fields: Name, Team, Hitting Arm (L/R), Backhand (1H/2H), UTR Rating.
Logic: A "Permanent Save" toggle. Only saved players appear in the "Players" tab directory.

3. Match Configuration (The "Setup" Screen)
Dynamic Inputs: Implement a "Start Match" button that remains disabled until Player 1, Player 2, and the Server are selected.
Logic Toggles: * Scoring Type: Simple vs. Shot Stats.
Rules: Ad/No-Ad, Tie-break/No Tie-break.
Formats: Sets (1, 3, 5, Pro Set, Fast4), Games per set (2-10).
Metadata: Court surface, speed, indoor/outdoor toggle, and weather fields (Temp, Humidity).

4. Active Match Logic (The "Core" Engine)
Scoreboard: Large digital font for points (0, 15, 30, 40, Ad). Implement tennis logic (e.g., if 40-40 and No-Ad, the next point wins the game).
Service Tracking: Toggle between "First Serve" and "Second Serve."
Point Entry Workflow (The "Popup"):
Trigger: Tapping a player's side opens the entry modal.
Level 1 (Outcome): Ace, Winner, Unforced Error (UE), Forced Error (FE).
Level 2 (Conditional): * If Winner/UE/FE: Show Forehand vs. Backhand -> Shot Kind (Slice, Volley, Lob, etc.) -> Location (Cross Court, Line, Middle) -> Rally Length.
If UE/FE: Show "Error Type" (Net, Long, Wide).
If Ace/Double Fault: Show Placement (T, Body, Wide).
Level 3 (Save): Clicking "Save Point" updates the score and the Match Log.

5. Data Visualization (Three-Way View)
Match Stats: A table showing % of 1st serves in, total winners, and break points won.
Shot Stats: A breakdown by shot type (e.g., "Forehand Winner: 1", "Backhand Return FE: 2").
Match Log: A text-based timeline of every point. Example: "Jake loses the point with a middle net backhand unforced error."

6. Technical UI Styles
Color Palette: Use Primary Blue (R:15 G:92 B:206) for active states and Light Grey (#F2F2F7) for backgrounds.
Components: Use segmented controls for toggles (Singles/Doubles), horizontal sliders for rally length, and card-based containers for match history.

**Defining App Core Features**

I'm solidifying the core features for "NTP Stat". I've decided on three bottom tabs: Matches, Players, and Shot Stats (for the active match). I'll also be using persistent local storage, which will be helpful for browser-based React. Finally, I've got the player fields sorted: Name, Team, and Hitting Arm (L/R).


**Expanding Feature Definition**

I've expanded the player details to include backhand type (1H/2H) and UTR rating. There's a "permanent save" toggle, match type (singles/doubles), player and server selections, and scoring type options. The rules section covers Ad/No-Ad, and tie-break rules. Also, format and metadata options have been included. I'm planning out the scoreboard, service tracking, and the hierarchical point entry modal. I'm also planning the color scheme and key UI components. Finally, I've got my file structure planned.
